title: [Shopify] Add Unlisted to Status for Created Products and update status tooltip
summary: The Shopify Status for Created Products option on the Shop Card now offers Unlisted, backed by a new codeunit implementing ICreateProductStatusValue. The Status field tooltip on the Shopify Products page now also lists unlisted.
key_points: Added Unlisted value to the Shpfy Cr. Prod. Status Value enum used by the Status for Created Products picker on the Shop Card
Updated Status field tooltip to include Unlisted alongside Active, Archived, and Draft
New codeunit Shpfy CreateProdStatusUnlisted implements ICreateProductStatusValue
New codeunit added to the Shpfy - Objects permission set
